rationale: Plan addresses each objective: load data foundation; claim_volume with status breakdown for portfolio composition; denial_rate and fraud_prevalence for prevalence questions; financial_summary for billed/allowed/paid amounts; monthly_trend for claim volume trends; write_report with synthetic/descriptive caveats and artifact citations for executive one-page brief. All required artifacts covered: status chart (claim_volume), monthly charts/table (monthly_trend), financial table (financial_summary), report (write_report), and metrics aggregated from component outputs.
